policies.title: Republic of Korea ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Korea MOFA destination guidance expressly gives these ordinary Korean-passport visitor exemptions.
conditions: BA, XK, PA and TN: up to 90 days on the respective Korea MOFA destination page.
This is an ordinary Republic of Korea passport short-visitor baseline only; work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Republic of Korea ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Korea MOFA destination guidance expressly identifies border-issued ordinary Korean-passport visitor visas.
conditions: KM: a 45-day visa is issued on arrival on production of a valid passport, return ticket and accommodation evidence. KH: ordinary passport holders can obtain a tourist visa at airport and land borders for one month.

Cambodia also offers an eVisa but that optional advance alternative does not displace its ordinary Korean-passport arrival-visa route. Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Republic of Korea ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Current Korea MOFA guidance states that Cuba made the electronic visa mandatory for travellers and identifies the official issuance site.
conditions: Obtain the Cuban electronic visa before travel through the official issuance site identified by Korea MOFA.
Cuba's D'VIAJEROS arrival declaration is a separate arrival form, not this electronic visa. Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa
steps: Apply for the electronic visa before departure using the ordinary Republic of Korea passport to be used for travel.
Carry the issued visa information and complete Cuba's separate arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.
